Meta appoints generative AI VP to run Threads
Meta appointed Connor Hayes, Meta’s VP of
Product for Generative AI, to become the head of
Threads, per Axios.
Until now, Instagram head Adam Mosseri has been
in charge of Threads. But the platform has grown
into more than a side product of Instagram,
necessitating additional leadership.
Though Threads only launched in 2023, its mobile
daily active user (DAU) numbers are fast
approaching those of X, according to market
intelligence provider Similarweb. Currently,
Threads is averaging around 115 million DAUs on
mobile, with X’s DAU numbers reaching around 132
million.
TechCrunch has reached out to Meta for comment.
